notes.title: Demo: Part I is OUT NOW!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45398393/3e5d70768e2244d79d82def6d06d594805bdcaac.png"][/img][/p][p]Hi, everyone! This is Eikou, Studio Lead of Startris Studio.[/p][p][/p][p]We're excited to announce that the Of The Lilies Demo: Part I is [b]out now[/b]! Here's what to expect from this first part:[/p][list][*][p][b]2 out of 5[/b] love interests (Lien and Seiji will be introduced in the first part of the demo. We're sorry Taji, Laisa, and Myo fans! 😭)[/p][/*][*][p]The prologue of the story, where you'll discover the main character's backstory[/p][/*][*][p]30 minutes to 1 hour of playtime with around 8,000+ words[/p][/*][*][p]Combat mini-game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We're working hard at development daily and we'll be patching missing features (like save/load, settings, auto, skip, and log functionalities) once we finish them. We're so grateful for your patience 💕[/p][p][/p][p]If you like our demo, it would mean so much to us if you could leave a review! This would greatly help with our visibility and bring Of The Lilies to more people 😭🙏🏼[/p][p][/p][p]We're also open to any feedback that you have! You can connect with us in our [url="https://bit.ly/OfTheLiliesServer"]Discord server[/url] or through our email at [url="https://startristeam@gmail.com"]startristeam@gmail.com[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for supporting Of The Lilies! There [b][i]will[/i][/b] be a Demo Part II, which will include all the love interests, so please stay tuned! 💜[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4020450/Of_The_Lilies_Demo_Part_I/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: We're live on Steam! 💜
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We’re live right now! 💜 Come join the dev team at our Discord server from 7PM to 8PM GMT+8 as we play through [i]Of The Lilies Demo: Part 1[/i] together. You can ask questions, chat with us, and take a look at the world we’ve been building 🫶🏼[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://bit.ly/OfTheLiliesServer" style="button" buttoncolor="#2b5f21"]Join our Discord Server here![/url][/p][p][/p][p]After the livestream, we'll be continuing the broadcast here at Steam, so you'll be able to see what you can expect from the demo we'll be releasing this month![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for all your support in our continued journey 🌺[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3348900/Of_The_Lilies/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: We're livestreaming Of The Lilies Demo: Part 1 this Friday!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone! 💜[/p][p][/p][p]This is Eikou, Studio Lead of Startris Studio. While we're waiting for Steam approval 😭🙏 we’d love to invite you to join the [b]Of The Lilies Demo: Part 1 livestream[/b] this [b]Friday, September 19, 2025[/b] at [b]7PM (GMT+8)[/b]! Come hang out with us, ask the devs questions, or watch us play the game! We're excited to get to know everyone 🫶🏼[/p][p][/p][p]Aside from the livestream this Friday, we also post weekly updates on our Discord server. If you want to follow our development journey as we build Of The Lilies, we'd be happy to have you there.[/p][p][/p][p]But don't worry, our demo will be available for everyone as soon as Steam gives us the go signal, so you’ll get to play it yourself soon too![/p][p][/p][h2][url="https://bit.ly/OfTheLiliesServer" style="button" buttoncolor="#394936"]Join the Of The Lilies Discord Server![/url][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45398393/7ec3a84fb977b5a7eae2c5d9dcc2e62b0e8643c3.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo: Part I Release Date 🌺
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! 💖[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve got some exciting updates to share! Alongside the reveal of our brand new key art (we’ve been dying to show you this one 🥺), we're thrilled to announce that the [b]first part[/b] of the [b]playable demo [/b]will be launching this [b]September 2025[/b]! 🎉[/p][p][/p][p]While we've showcased the demo in local and international events before, this demo will include more gameplay, more CGs, and will feature [b]two out of five love interests[/b] 🗡️ You'll be able to uncover the main character's backstory before the story unfolds further in the second part of the demo, which will be announced at a later date![/p][p][/p][p]We can’t wait to hear your thoughts once you get your hands on it! In the meantime, let us know what you think of the new key art in the comments below! We’d love to hear your first impressions 👀 Who caught your eye?[/p][p][/p][p]You'll be able to get more updates by joining our Discord server [url="https://bit.ly/OfTheLiliesServer"]here[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much! We're excited to share what we've been working on, please stay tuned! ✨[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45398393/a7d1747ffa486e67c90dcfa3b8b00dc84ecc8c59.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
